RTL scripts (Arabic, Hebrew) are not supported for editing: PyMuPDF applies contextual shaping before drawing, so texttrace reports shaped presentation-form glyphs, not logical characters -- a literal find/replace against logical RTL text will not match. Documented in tests/engine/test_font_cjk.py's module docstring; not attempted.
CJK vertical writing mode is not supported: Page.insert_font(..., wmode=1) did not produce vertical text through the API path tried. Also documented there, also not attempted.

fit=True (FNT-10) fragments a span's texttrace into one span per character, breaking a second edit's ability to find that text as one span -- documented as a known trade-off in engine/edit.py's replace_span_text docstring, defaults to False

font-name matching between texttrace and Page.get_fonts()/pikepdf now goes through engine.fonts.match.normalize_font_name plus a containment-match fallback in two places (engine/edit.py's _find_font_entry and engine/fonts/tounicode.py's recover_broken_spans) -- three real, distinct name-mismatch bugs were found this way across P2; reuse this same pattern rather than comparing font-name strings directly anywhere new
